source: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, subject 82 trial 06 (pushing on a heavy object), BVH conversion by B. Hahne; side-plane projection by bvh2d.py
credit: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
units: angles in degrees: torso = hips->neck from vertical (+ forward); thigh from vertical (+ forward); knee/elbow flexion; upper = shoulder->elbow world angle (+ forward); head relative to torso. pts = side-plane points [forward, up] in capture units; hipH = standing hip height in the same units
